papers.title: Sleep-related threat processing in chronic insomnia: A psychosomatic framework for hyperarousal, learning, and treatment
papers.reason: The paper proposes a cognitive-affective framework involving selective attention, learning, and predictive processing in insomnia, but executive function modelling or assessment is peripheral.

papers.title: Interpreting Functional Connectivity in Alzheimer’s Disease as Cognitive Processes: Multinomial Processing Trees and the Common Model of Cognition
papers.reason: The paper directly combines Bayesian cognitive process modelling with functional connectivity in Alzheimer's and MCI to interpret retrieval and working-memory-related processes.

papers.title: Reinforced hippocampus-accumbens pathway marks a shift toward cognitive decline in aging.
papers.reason: The paper reports mechanistic animal and human neuroimaging findings on navigation, memory, goal-directed behavior, and aging-related cognitive decline that could inform cognitive models.

papers.title: Research Progress on Peripheral Physiological Responses and Central Neural Activity Characteristics of Competitive Anxiety
papers.reason: The review touches attentional networks, executive function, EEG oscillations, and cognitive interference, but its core focus is competitive anxiety physiology rather than executive function modelling.

papers.title: A Latent Variable Perspective on EEG Measures of Attentional Control
papers.reason: The study directly examines EEG and behavioural measures of attentional control across Stroop, Simon, go/no-go, and change-detection tasks using latent-variable modelling.

papers.title: Connectome fingerprinting predicts prefrontal cortical activation during abstract reasoning
papers.reason: The paper uses individual connectome-based prediction of prefrontal activation during abstract reasoning, making it relevant to higher-order cognition but more methodological than process-oriented.
